svg.aria-label: Space Zap Z80 64 KB memory map, ROMs, TERSE runtime and stacks
svg.text: Access behavior not yet validated against the Space Zap board.
Startup places BC's working state and the two downward-growing
stacks in this address block; complete RAM ownership is still open.
Physical RAM/device decode and access behavior pending validation.
Do not assume ROM, RAM or mirrored graphics without board evidence.
Astrocade-family video address region; Space Zap-specific read/write
semantics require verification against the arcade hardware map.
Four 4 KB MAME ROM sockets; indexed-token interpreter and game data.
Only the ROM read map is established here; graphics write semantics need verification.
BC token -> 16-bit vector table -> native handler -> JP (IY) -> NEXT.
SP=$D780 and IX=$D800 at cold start; both grow downward.
